sender: members app (app/src/lib/notify.ts: Resend or Postmark). Shopify sends only its own order confirmation.
audience: Starter Books buyers who are not members (orders/paid with an ebook line and no membership line)
rules: Stop the offer blocks the moment the buyer becomes a member (orders/paid with a membership line).
Every offer block states price, interval, that it renews until cancelled, and cancel online anytime (SAFETY_RULES S-02).
Offer links go to the membership page (terms + unticked consent checkbox), never to a cart permalink.
{{COUNT_LINE}} follows the FUNNEL.md rule using the live founding inventory; never a countdown.
No SMS lines until SMS_ENABLED=true. Footer full contrast, no gray text. One button per email, 60px, Persimmon #B3311C with white text.
